<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>body{background:#151923;color:#eee;font:14px system-ui;margin:12px}canvas{display:block;width:100%;max-width:920px;border:1px solid #856b43}button,input{accent-color:#d5ae68;background:#303747;color:#eee;padding:7px}label{display:inline-block;margin:8px}small{color:#cdbb9c}</style></head><body><h2>Ironbound — Illustrated Slash v5</h2><canvas id="c" width="920" height="588"></canvas><button id="play">Pause</button><button id="restart">Restart</button><label>Speed <input id="speed" type="range" min=".25" max="1.5" step=".25" value="1"></label><label>Timeline <input id="time" type="range" min="0" max="1250" step="1" value="0"></label><label>Size <input id="size" type="range" min=".7" max="1.3" step=".05" value="1"></label><label><input type="checkbox" id="loop" checked> Loop</label><p id="readout"></p><small>13 illustrated frames from the approved concept. Original artwork is not warped or segmented. Motion timing is authored from the Slash keyframes; pivots are a reference, not live sprite controls.</small><script>
const sources=/*SHARED_SCENE*/{},frames=[{"src":"data:image/webp;base64,","w":98,"h":115},{"src":"data:image/webp;base64,","w":93,"h":112},{"src":"data:image/webp;base64,","w":92,"h":115},{"src":"data:image/webp;base64,","w":90,"h":136},{"src":"data:image/webp;base64,","w":89,"h":138},{"src":"data:image/webp;base64,","w":103,"h":129},{"src":"data:image/webp;base64,","w":185,"h":128},{"src":"data:image/webp;base64,","w":162,"h":117},{"src":"data:image/webp;base64,","w":164,"h":106},{"src":"data:image/webp;base64,","w":140,"h":86},{"src":"data:image/webp;base64,","w":108,"h":95},{"src":"data:image/webp;base64,","w":87,"h":108},{"src":"data:image/webp;base64,","w":92,"h":112}];const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),c=$('c'),ctx=c.getContext('2d'),I={};for(let [id,src] of Object.entries(sources)){let im=new Image();im.onload=()=>I[id]=im;im.src=src}for(let f of frames){f.im=new Image();f.im.src=f.src}
const starts=[0,100,190,260,310,390,475,550,635,760,900,1060,1170];
// Measured helmet/foot height anchors keep weapon poses from changing character scale.
const anchors=[.60,.60,.60,.60,.60,.57,.53,.54,.53,.53,.57,.60,.60];
const lunge=[[0,0],[300,-.025],[550,.16],[760,.19],[1250,0]];
function root(t){for(let i=1;i<lunge.length;i++){let [b,y]=lunge[i],[a,x]=lunge[i-1];if(t<=b){let u=(t-a)/(b-a);return x+(y-x)*u*u*(3-2*u)}}return 0}
let t=0,last=0,playing=true;function stop(){playing=false;$('play').textContent='Play'}$('play').onclick=()=>{if(playing)stop();else{if(t>=1250)t=0;playing=true;$('play').textContent='Pause'}};$('restart').onclick=()=>{t=0;playing=true;$('play').textContent='Pause'};$('time').oninput=()=>{stop();t=+$('time').value};
function draw(now){if(last&&playing)t+=Math.min(now-last,60)*(+$('speed').value);last=now;if(t>=1250){if($('loop').checked)t%=1250;else{t=1250;stop()}}ctx.setTransform(2,0,0,2,0,0);ctx.clearRect(0,0,460,294);if(I.bg)ctx.drawImage(I.bg,0,0,460,294);else{ctx.fillStyle='#202630';ctx.fillRect(0,0,460,294)}let i=starts.findLastIndex(x=>x<=t),f=frames[Math.max(i,0)],k=+$('size').value;let x=105+root(t)*190*k,y=279;
// Uniform pixel scaling across frames. All poses share a common floor line.
let scale=1.58*k,w=f.w*scale,h=f.h*scale;ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y-3);ctx.scale(43*k,6*k);let g=ctx.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,1);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,.65)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(-1,-1,2,2);ctx.restore();if(f.im.complete&&f.im.naturalWidth)ctx.drawImage(f.im,x-w*anchors[i],y-h,w,h);if(I.fg)ctx.drawImage(I.fg,0,0,460,294);if(I.fade)ctx.drawImage(I.fade,0,256,460,38);$('time').value=Math.round(t);$('readout').textContent='Frame '+(i+1)+' / 13 · '+Math.round(t)+' ms';requestAnimationFrame(draw)}requestAnimationFrame(draw);
</script></body></html>
